text:
- Find a clearer starting point. Open Browse or Add comics directly from Home, with simpler guidance and no empty-list review action.
- Explore more reading guides. Follow Iron Fist, Namor, Shang-Chi, Nova, Ultimate Spider-Man, the Infinity trilogy and more through credited character, creator and event Reading Lists.
- Keep missing source positions visible. Unresolved original comics remain explicit gaps rather than being silently removed or replaced with different editions. Existing saved lists are not rewritten.
- Open the recorded issue page. When a Reading List already has an exact Marvel page but no reader ID, use that page without repeating a lookup known to fail.
- Reduce repeated announcements. Decorative catalog placeholders no longer repeat guide names in screen-reader content; guide headings, credits and actions remain available.
- Know which copy is running. About identifies packaged builds and their source separately from the product version.
- Keep your place. Saved data and JSON backups from 3.0.1 remain compatible. Export a backup first, use the same local address and browser profile, and stay on version 3 or later.
